verdict.rationale: Zapier documents narrow AI-generated suggestion features tied to specific data: AI-generated troubleshooting instructions for failed Zaps and Canvas's automatic process mapping/optimization, but there is no evidence of a broader AI insights/analytics layer that surfaces suggestions from a user's overall automation or business data inside the product. Missing for 10: a dedicated insights/analytics feature analyzing user data more broadly, independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI suggestion features actually working well.
